name: Elon Musk

career.title: Co-founder and CEO of X.com (merged with Confinity, later PayPal)
Lead Series A investor and chairman
Owner and CEO after $44 billion acquisition

background_rationale: A serial entrepreneur who co-founded Zip2 and X.com and founded SpaceX, and was Tesla's lead early investor and chairman before taking over as CEO in 2008.

notable.summary: Tesla shareholders approved a performance-based 2025 CEO Performance Award for Musk, granted by the board in September 2025, by about 1.89 billion votes to 565 million.
Tesla agreed to invest about $2 billion in preferred stock of Musk's AI company xAI, after reporting that 2025 vehicle deliveries fell 9% and revenue fell 3%.
Tesla began removing safety monitors from its Robotaxi vehicles in Austin, Texas.

Tesla reported it had begun Cybercab production at Gigafactory Texas, had Robotaxi operating in seven metro areas, and was installing Optimus robot production lines at Fremont in place of Model S/X lines.

personal_story.hook: At 12, Elon Musk sold a video game he had coded himself for about $500.
personal_story.summary: Musk was born in 1971 in Pretoria, South Africa, and was severely bullied as a child. He became interested in computers around age 10, taught himself programming from a VIC-20 manual, and at 12 sold his BASIC game Blastar for about $500; he has credited part of his success to reading books like The Lord of the Rings, the Foundation series and The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy. At 17 he emigrated to Canada, partly to avoid South African military service, studied at Queen's University, then transferred to the University of Pennsylvania. Accepted to a Stanford graduate program in 1995, he did not enroll and instead co-founded Zip2; its 1999 sale and the later sale of PayPal funded SpaceX and his early investment in Tesla.

facts.label: Early ambition
facts.value: Taught himself programming; sold the game Blastar at age 12

facts.label: Turning point
facts.value: Skipped a Stanford materials science graduate program in 1995 to start Zip2

facts.label: Other
